blocks.text: Product Overview: This Lenovo 15.6" IdeaPad Laptop is perfect working for Home, Student, Professionals, Small Business, School Education, and Commercial Enterprise, Online Class, Google Classroom, Remote Learning, Zoom Ready. Specifications Processor: Intel® Pentium® Silver N6000 Processor Operating system: Windows 11 Home 64-bit in S mode Graphics: Integrated Intel® UHD Graphics Memory: 8GB DDR4 SDRAM Hard Drive: 512GB PCIe SSD + 128GB eMMC Display: 15.6" LCD with LED-Backlit Anti-Glare FHD (1920 x 1080) Display Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6 (2x2/160) Gig+ and Bluetooth® 5.0 Audio: 2 x 1.5W Speakers with Dolby Audio Built-in HD Webcam: 720P Camera and Dual Array Microphones Ports: 1 x USB 3.0 Type A 1 x USB 3.0 Type C 1 x USB 2.0 Type A 1 x HDMI-Out 1 x AC Smart Pin 1 x Multi-format SD media card reader 1 x Headphone / Mic Combo Jack Battery Life (up to): 9.50 hours Color: Blue Dimensions L x W x H (inches): 14.2 x 9.2 x 0.7 inches Weight: 3.52 lbs Productivity Software: • 1-Year Subscription for Microsoft Office 365 Personal • Microsoft 365 Personal (1-Year) is pre-installed. • The latest versions of: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook (Publisher and Access are available on PC only). • An extra 1TB of online storage in OneDrive. • 60 minutes of Skype™ calls each month to phones in 60+ countries.
